2024-02-05

Open data

data_ENI <- read.csv(file="G:/Scripts_data_postdoc/5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.2. Models/Raw/dataset_500_ENI_Lea.csv")%>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as_factor(id_parcelle),
         annee=as_factor(annee),
         type_production=as_factor(type_production),
         region_biogeo=as_factor(region_biogeo),
         RegionAgricole=as_factor(RegionAgricole),
         TypeCulture=as_factor(TypeCulture),
         clust=as_factor(clust),
         code_parcelle=as_factor(code_parcelle),
         exposition2=as_factor(exposition2))

1. % of Entomogamous

1.1. Biogeo regions

mod_reg <- aov(entomogame_1 ~ region_biogeo, data=data_ENI)
summary(mod_reg)
##                 Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)    
## region_biogeo    9   7.81  0.8682   30.66 <2e-16 ***
## Residuals     2400  67.95  0.0283                   
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
pairwise.t.test(data_ENI$entomogame_1, data_ENI$region_biogeo, p.adj = "bonferroni")
## 
##  Pairwise comparisons using t tests with pooled SD 
## 
## data:  data_ENI$entomogame_1 and data_ENI$region_biogeo 
## 
##      MC      BRSJ    ZM      A       ZNE     MA      BPS     C       BPN    
## BRSJ 1.00000 -       -       -       -       -       -       -       -      
## ZM   2.0e-08 7.0e-11 -       -       -       -       -       -       -      
## A    0.00014 1.4e-05 1.00000 -       -       -       -       -       -      
## ZNE  0.74240 1.00000 < 2e-16 3.9e-07 -       -       -       -       -      
## MA   1.7e-06 0.00163 < 2e-16 6.8e-11 0.00086 -       -       -       -      
## BPS  1.00000 1.00000 < 2e-16 1.3e-05 1.00000 1.2e-07 -       -       -      
## C    1.00000 1.00000 0.98375 0.06358 0.19068 7.8e-05 1.00000 -       -      
## BPN  0.00018 0.05032 < 2e-16 1.0e-09 0.07799 1.00000 4.9e-05 0.00108 -      
## ZSO  1.00000 1.00000 6.3e-11 0.00037 3.0e-05 1.9e-15 0.48233 1.00000 8.4e-12
## 
## P value adjustment method: bonferroni
             Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)

region_biogeo 9 7.72 0.8574 30.47 <2e-16 *** Residuals 2450 68.94 0.0281

Plus d’entomogames en ZM et en A que dans toutes les autres régions sauf C Plus d’entomogames en C qu’en MA et BPNord Moins d’entomogames en MA et en BPN que dans toutes les régions

ggplot(data= data_ENI) + 
  aes(x= region_biogeo, y = entomogame_1) +
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.1)+
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.3,fill='#A4A4A4', color = "black")+
  labs(x="Région", y = "% entomo")+
  labs(fill = "% entomo")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=16),
        axis.title=element_text(size=20))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size=20),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14))+ 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

1.2. Clusters

mod_clust <- aov(entomogame_1 ~ clust, data=data_ENI)
summary(mod_clust)
##               Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)    
## clust          2   5.27  2.6350   89.97 <2e-16 ***
## Residuals   2407  70.50  0.0293                   
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
pairwise.t.test(data_ENI$entomogame_1, data_ENI$clust, p.adj = "bonferroni")
## 
##  Pairwise comparisons using t tests with pooled SD 
## 
## data:  data_ENI$entomogame_1 and data_ENI$clust 
## 
##   1      2     
## 2 <2e-16 -     
## 3 0.11   <2e-16
## 
## P value adjustment method: bonferroni
mod_clust <- aov(nectar_present_1 ~ clust, data=data_ENI)
summary(mod_clust)

## Residuals   2407  61.01  0.0253

pairwise.t.test(data_ENI$nectar_present_1, data_ENI$clust, p.adj = "bonferroni")

##  Pairwise comparisons using t tests with pooled SD 
## 
## data:  data_ENI$nectar_present_1 and data_ENI$clust 
## 
##   1      2     
## 2 <2e-16 -     
## 3 0.013  <2e-16
## 
## P value adjustment method: bonferroni

Pas diff 1 et 3 Diff 1 et 2 Diff 2 et 3

ggplot(data= data_ENI) + 
  aes(x= clust, y = entomogame_1,fill=clust) +
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.1)+
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#0073C2FF","#EFC000FF","#868686FF"))+
  labs(x="Cluster", y = "% entomo")+
  labs(fill = "% entomo")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=16),
        axis.title=element_text(size=20))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size=20),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14))+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("1","2"),c("1","3"),c("2","3")),map_signif_level = TRUE)+ theme(legend.position = "none")
